ascents.comment: First of the grade… didn’t feel too much harder than no late tenders, though unclear whether the start was supposed to be left like no late benders?
Funny little boulder 😂 don’t think I’ve ever used my stomach to help me climb before
Such a proud and beautiful boulder ❤️
Fun! First move crux getting onto the boulder 😅
Everyone says it’s just picturesque and doesn’t climb well, but I actually quite enjoyed the movement! ⭐️
Foot first beta for the bit
Left heel toe cam was clutch - def just more pumpy than anything. Way easier than Pinotage for me

Wowieee what a beautiful line 😍 and it climbs so well! One of the best of the grade. 

Lots of foam was nice. Careful at the top - someone pulled some rock off the top of the boulder today (luckily didn’t fall, nor did it land on us spotting)
